title: The singer at the EM Club
description: A singer in a black sequined gown and a pearl necklace stands at the microphone with her arms spread wide mid-song, smiling; a drummer in a blue floral shirt plays a pearl-finish kit behind her, guitars and amplifiers crowd the little stage, and the room is full to the back wall — fatigues, a few civilian shirts, one woman in purple at the rear. Two crew-cut heads in the foreground watch from the front row. "Entertainment at the EM Club in Ton Suhn Nhut. About 50 yards from my hooch."
researchNotes: Captioned with VN-0030 on 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0034-c18308456.json). The singer and band are unidentified. The survey wondered whether one of the two foreground heads is Larry's; he did not say, and he was not asked.
